item.title: Van left on chesworth close, 12th August
item.description:
The van has been left overhanging residents driveway since Tuesday 4th August. Resident struggling to get on and off driveway due to the van overhanging the drop curb. Company that driver worked for has been contacted several times, company confirmed van broken down and promised to respond each time but no communication received and no attempt at removal or attending the van since it was left. Van window has been left open, bottle of urine left on the curb.
